items.title: Josh Downs: Likely playing Sunday
items.text:
Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Friday that Downs looks ready to play in Sunday's game at Atlanta, Charles Goldman of AtoZ Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emmett Johnson: Could lead backfield Sunday
items.text:
Coach Andy Reid noted that Johnson would take the bulk of the Chiefs' carries in the event that Kenneth Walker -- who didn't practice Friday due to groin tightness -- is forced to miss Sunday's game against the Falcons, Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Sits out Friday's practice
items.text:
Walker (groin) sat out Friday's practice due to groin tightness, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Listed as questionable, but improving
items.text:
Boston (toe), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN,  is trending in the right direction ahead of the contest.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jonathon Brooks: Listed as doubtful for Week 10
items.text:
Brooks (groin) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at New Orleans after being limited in practice throughout the week, Kassidy Hill of panthers.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
